verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The quotient is defined verbatim and the implication |Z_*| ≤ δ_* ⇒ χ > .99 is the conclusion of `ideal_prefix_cutoff_parameters`, with .99 as 99/100 and δ_*, σ_* existentially produced exactly as the paper chooses them (the proof instantiates δ = j/10 and σ = √m/20, where m is the compact minimum of H_*² on {|Z_*| ≤ δ}); the paper's intermediate step 'choose δ_* so that {|Z_*| ≤ δ_*} avoids a neighborhood of η₀' is internal to the Lean proof (`low_Z_has_H_margin`) rather than a separate statement. One domain difference, from the sentence following the display: the paper makes these choices on a slightly larger compact interval I ⊃ [-1,1], whereas every Lean statement of the χ > .99 cutoff I found quantifies η over Icc (-1) 1. The holomorphic companion `NaturalAxisCoefficients.complexChi` and the enlarged window [-11/10, 11/10] exist, but I found no declaration asserting the cutoff on that window.
